regime_context: The detector shows a defensive, trend-confirmed concentration but a narrowing and thinning rotation. The leader rank (Memory/HBM) is NOT eligible, while all top eligible ranks (Big Pharma, Health Care, Defensives, Staples, Retail) are crowded and trend-healthy; the absolute-trend gate is validated on this market, so the only sanctioned edge is avoiding de-gating/drawdown, not chasing rank. Macro narrative is dominated by AI/tech headlines with very high unscheduled-news share (79%), which is noise, not a trigger.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the non-AI energy/industrial cluster (US Energy Complex, Industrial Distribution, Reshoring) can CONFIRM a leadership handoff away from the crowded defensive complex — the observable condition is three consecutive higher weekly closes in XLE/XLI WITHOUT any further crowding flag, while Big Pharma's durability_bar drops below 0.7.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the highest-ranked ELIGIBLE theme under a trend gate and has the strongest detector legs: eligible=true, durability_bar=0.85 (highest in the board), hurst=trend, and breadth=1.0 (full participation). Crowding is elevated but treated only as a size-down caution, not a fade. The lean is a continuation of the confirmed defensive trend, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowding at 1.48z alongside a full-defensive board suggests the leadership is already reflexively loaded; trend continuation in crowded late-stage leaders historically underperforms the gate's drawdown benefit.

falsifier.text: PPH prints a lower low on the daily chart and loses its absolute trend gate (eligible flips false) before 30 trading days

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care (EW) is the diversified expression of the same confirmed defensive trend as Big Pharma: eligible=true, durability_bar=0.81, breadth=0.933, and hurst=trend. It carries crowding risk too, but the equal-weight structure reduces single-name concentration while still capturing the trend-gate benefit.
theses.dissent: Elevated crowding across the healthcare complex (XLV crowding_z=1.56) raises the risk that any drawdown is sharp because positioning is one-sided.

falsifier.text: XLV rolls over and closes below its 100-day average while breadth drops under 0.7 before the 30-day check

theses.subject: Defensives
theses.thesis: Defensives (proxied by XLP/XLU) is eligible, trend-healthy (durability_bar=0.82), broad (0.833), and confirms the same defensive rotation as staples and healthcare. It is unscorable per the detector but the lean is structural: staying with the confirmed trend family while crowded, not fading it.
theses.dissent: No clean single-proxy score makes the call hard to grade; if the defensive complex is already fully loaded (crowded across staples/healthcare), upside follow-through is limited.

falsifier.text: XLP breaks down relative to SPY by 3% while the absolute trend gate for the defensive family flips false before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
